# PV-Tech: China hits another record high with 277.17 GW of new PV in 2024

Published: 22 Jan 2025. By Carrie Xiao.

## Key Findings
- Total PV capacity: **886.66 GW** at end 2024, up **45.5%** from 609.49 GW at end 2023.
- 2024 new PV installations: **277.17 GW** — record high for annual installations.
- **December 2024 alone: 70.87 GW** installed (record; vs 53 GW in Dec 2023).
- Q4 rush: major power generation groups rush to install to achieve annual targets.
- 2023: new PV installations exceeded 200 GW (+148% YoY).
- 2024 growth rate slowed to **just under 28%** — lowest since 2019.
